title: THE MARKET IS TALKING
author: FelixFelixFelix
facts: derived at read time: each block's weights come from live market activity and are not stored
description: This network has no fixed weights. Its hidden layers are two groups of live token markets. Ethereum adds data in numbered groups called blocks. For each new block, the network derives new weights from the trading activity of those tokens. Ethereum stores the program that builds the network and writes its output, and your browser runs it. The output is one sentence for each block, from a 299-word vocabulary. The contract returns the saved state for a past block, so anyone can compute that sentence again.

call.note: stateAt(blockNumber) returns the saved inputs and mood for the selected block. The project’s program uses these values to rebuild the network.

input.label: BLOCK NUMBER
input.hint: Enter an Ethereum block number. The live check shows saved model state. It does not write the sentence.
